messages:
Marta R.: Heads-up: partner (hw_vendor_id=307) reported sudden spike in APAC usage yesterday morning. Appears correlated with DST shift.
Evan: Spike how big? Percent?
Marta R.: ~320% in aggregate for APAC zone between 2026-03-28T00:00:00+09:00 and +09:30. Not in EU/US.
Device GW: We received batched device-hour records with timezone_offset field set to 0 for a subset of gateways; looks like older firmware ignoring local tz after DST switchover.
Akiko: That will shift device-hour buckets backward for Japan/Korea. Likely double-counting the late-night hour.
BillingBot: Alert: 1,842 device-hour entries flagged as out-of-window for billing aggregation. Potential overcharge if not reconciled.
Evan: Can someone run a quick query to show affected customers and entries?
Marta R.: SQL I ran to identify suspect rows:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, device_id, recorded_hour, timezone_offset, count(*) as cnt
FROM device_usage_batch
WHERE vendor_id = 307
  AND recorded_hour >= '2026-03-28T00:00:00Z'
  AND recorded_hour < '2026-03-28T02:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id, device_id, recorded_hour, timezone_offset
HAVING timezone_offset = 0 AND cnt > 0;
```
Akiko: Results: 14 customers in APAC affected, mostly in Japan (9) and Korea (3), plus two test accounts. Total inflated token-equivalent ~ 45k units.
InfraOps: Short-term mitigation: enable a correction pass that applies vendor-side reported local_time when timezone_offset is zero and vendor firmware version < 2.4.2. I'll stand up the worker.
Evan: Need to ensure reserved-capacity customers excluded from crediting flow. Any of the 14 reserved?
Marta R.: Two reserved customers found; flagged to exclude.
Device GW: We can produce corrected payloads (with computed timezone_offset) if partner wants; they'll need to replay for backfill.
Akiko: We should keep a preserved copy of original rows for audit; plan: collapse duplicates by preferring corrected_local_time and mark originals as reconciled=false.
BillingBot: Recommended action: create credits_backfill record for non-reserved customers and schedule ledger reversal for inflated entries.
Evan: Draft reconciliation steps:
1) Snapshot affected rows and export to partner admin console
2) Compute corrected_hour = recorded_hour + vendor_local_offset
3) Collapse duplicate device-hour rows by device_id+corrected_hour keeping max(observed_usage)
4) Generate credits for delta where billed > corrected_usage and exclude reserved contracts
5) Partner to replay corrected payloads for historical audit if they want ledger parity
Akiko: I'll draft the reversal SQL for step 3/4.
Marta R.: Thanks. Timeline: InfraOps to run correction pass within 2 hours, Akiko to produce reversal SQL, partner to confirm replay window by EOD JST.
InfraOps: Correction pass scheduled at 2026-03-28T02:15:00+09:00, worker scaled.
Device GW: Partner accepted replay; they'll pause automatic gateway reboots until patch deployed.
BillingBot: Closed loop: 12 customers reconciled, 2 reserved excluded, total credit issued: 42,300 token-equivalents.
Marta R.: Good catch team. Please attach final reconciliation CSV to the partner record and mark this thread when complete.
Evan: Will add links and close after ledger job completes.
